limits: Final-delivery strict score is not raw model intent accuracy: backend pruning and a second text-verification call can remove initially over-read references. Initial proposal score and actual read counts are retained.
Same source-grounded anchors/equivalents and complementary statement+solution interval rule as prior comparison. No answer-key goals or oracle IDs sent to models.
32 unique cases per model: original 24 plus 8 frozen fresh holdouts; repeated wording intentionally has different prior coverage. Original cases informed development, not unseen generalization.
Unused question echo outside clarify was normalized from cached replies; a deterministic backend normalization, not a model retry or policy/oracle change. Original partial results retained.
Known alternative IDs accompanying a clarify/no_new status are validated then discarded, never read. Derived reports record cached no-read normalization separately and preserve raw replies/results.
Gemma not retried: prior terminal 429 on same full-index input and no evidence of changed quota.
No OCR or teacher-generation requests. Tests assess routing/delivery, not pedagogical or scientific correctness of final explanations.
Provider-reported token counters only; missing Sol counters remain unknown. Actual prices/invoices not inferred.
Latency includes route, actual reads and verification for answered cases; observed sequential sample under pacing, not a causal benchmark.
